name: razai-sistema
description: Sistema desktop Razai — Gestão e Engenharia Têxtil
author: Razai

scripts.build:native: dotnet publish native/windows-share/WindowsShare.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o resources/bin
scripts.build:win: npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:win: npm run build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --dir
